headline: BRITAIN DECLARES WAR ON GERMANY; EMPIRE MOBILISES AT STROKE OF MIDNIGHT
dispatch: London, August 5, 1914. The United Kingdom formally declared war on Germany last night after Berlin ignored an ultimatum demanding the withdrawal of German forces from Belgium. Foreign Secretary Sir Edward Grey informed the House of Commons that the Treaty of London obligated Britain to defend Belgian neutrality. Mobilisation orders went out immediately to army and naval reserves across the empire.
answer: Britain declares war on Germany, starting WWI, 1914
